data.title: 爱丽丝 · 圣堂露台的月华金丝寝袍
data.description: 央都白玉宫殿的高层露台上，清澈的夜风吹拂着四周沉睡的云海。卸去金甲的整合骑士爱丽丝，身穿一袭纯白真丝长款寝袍倚在雕花白理石栏杆旁。一头璀璨如金的柔顺长发在月华下流光溢彩，睡袍系带微松，展现出圣洁高贵而又充满女性柔美的精致锁骨。她回眸凝望，湛蓝眼眸中满是历经沧桑后的深切眷恋。
data.action: leaning on white marble palace balustrade under moonlit clouds, pure white silk nightgown slipping slightly off shoulder, golden hair flowing in wind, deep tender blue eyes
data.location: high marble balcony of Central Cathedral overlooking a sea of starlit clouds
data.lighting: pure celestial silver moonlight bathing white marble and flowing gold hair
data.mood: sacred knightly devotion, ethereal celestial romance
data.promptProse: Standing on a high marble cathedral balcony above an ocean of starlit clouds, Alice Synthesis Thirty wears an elegant white silk nightgown. Her golden hair billows in the night wind as her blue eyes gaze with serene, sacred tenderness.
data.animaCaption: Alice in a flowing white nightgown standing on a celestial marble balcony under the moon.
